worktree_state: P01 integration is in progress; reviewed source hashes below are the exact read-only inputs.

findings.preserve: Latest durable callback dispatches analysis/settlement before history; draw and settlement task already share a transaction; history uses 8-row chunks.
findings.gap: The fetch looper still completes history and telemetry before scheduling its next request; current/history wait priority must stay distinct. Actual per-request first-byte/body-end timing is absent.
findings.minimal: Keep existing ingress/outbox; move optional history/telemetry to existing bounded background owner. ApiClient/FetchLedger changes are necessary for genuine wire-stage timestamps; service outer timing cannot substitute.

findings.gap: begin synchronously waits up to three 2-second receipt attempts before HTTP; receivedMono is sampled in complete after stream closure/disconnect. No first-byte timestamp or 1000-opportunity distribution is established.
findings.minimal: Capture monotonic request/header-or-first-read/body-end at transport execution; preserve durable binding and make telemetry admission explicit. Report missing/invalid/late periods and denominator.

findings.preserve: Single owner, no timeout replacement of live worker, fixed target deadline, same-target immutable hash conflict, strict commit-before-open and first_seen, fixed K3 and no model call by OOS labeler.
findings.gap: Named phase budgets/fast-vs-full provenance are incomplete; realtime history preparation may perform synchronous HTTP bootstrap.
findings.minimal: Add measured prepare/infer/finalize boundaries to the existing owner and use published immutable model references; no FAST overwrite, new REAL gate or synthetic prediction.

findings.gap: Feedback is called inside core settlement transaction, so missing research schema/feedback conflict can roll back valid OOS/task terminal despite core-isolation comment. Existing terminal returns skip feedback reconciliation.
findings.minimal: Use durable draw/task and strict-label sources as reconstructible outbox; reconcile research events independently after core commit and for already-terminal tasks.

findings.gap: Only settlement calls producer. r26_feedback has issue_ordinal UNIQUE and legacy R26_SETTLED id, so two semantic event types cannot be inserted into it. Live/legacy training waits for this event even if a valid draw exists.
findings.minimal: Generate DRAW_LABEL_REVEALED from confirmed draws independently of frozen predictions; generate FROZEN_RESULT only from original strict frozen labels. Preserve existing r26_feedback compatibility and add versioned role/event receipts tied to actual model checkpoint transactions.

findings.gap: TaskClaim already carries leaseGeneration/processBootId; terminal CAS omits those, retry CAS also omits draw_hash. Same textual owner can therefore accept a stale generation receipt.
findings.minimal: Use target/status/owner/draw_hash/lease_generation/process_boot_id in both terminal and retry predicates; zero affected rows is stale receipt evidence, never new-owner mutation.

findings.gap: A single terminal resets global pending_settlement_count to zero. Original heartbeat last-success is 202611020847 while database snapshot has 202611030010 COMPLETED and settled=1. These observations do not prove a 10-hour settlement outage.
findings.minimal: Publish separate sampled watermarks for latest_draw/latest_terminal/latest_valid_oos/latest_real/per-consumer checkpoint. Preserve unknown pending; compare only identified source snapshots and sampling times.

findings.gap: Service treats isRunning as research ownership/health; heartbeat still derives research freshness from legacy learning_pump. P01 task-level durable progress and quarantine facts are not mapped into service recovery.
findings.minimal: Task-runtime owner supplies immutable RuntimeCoordinatorR26.RuntimeHealthSnapshot from bounded joined task/progress/control snapshot; service control tick records separate process/realtime/research dimensions and requests existing-owner wake/half-open recovery.

findings.gap: Recovery lease uses wall deadline and PID, service-ready immediately writes recovery result OK, and a living degraded process is sent another foreground-service start.
findings.minimal: Bind recovery request id/owner epoch/boot+elapsed deadline/state; distinguish requested/actual-start/progress-confirmed recovered. If active service can accept control request, reconcile existing owner without another foreground-service start.

findings.preserve: Current target28/dataSync, stopWithTask=false, user-stop recovery cancellation, task-removal worker dispatch, bounded 60s wake lease renewed at 15s, API30 exit history already exist.
findings.gap: No device screen-off/Doze/OEM/force-stop/72h evidence; exit-history text does not itself prove force-stop capability or continuous training.
findings.minimal: Keep target/service type; expose verifiable OS restrictions and actual observed gaps separately from OEM user claims. Renewals must never count as artifact progress. Reuse existing exit history rather than duplicate it.

cross_owner_contract: RuntimeCoordinator/ResearchPool remain task_runtime-owned; SchemaDomain migration remains root-owned; ApiClient/FetchLedger ownership must be assigned before transport timestamp implementation.
